title: Register the Sonar plugin in nx.json
description: Adds the plugin to nx.json plugins when it is not registered yet, and optionally sets the prefix of default project keys.

projectKeyPrefix.description: Put before the project name to build the default projectKey of the configuration generator. Stored as options.projectKeyPrefix on the plugin entry. No prefix when omitted.

skipFormat.description: Skip formatting the files the generator changed.
